summary: Frontend-only verification of the internal Patients lookup UX bug fix on Preview. All four UX behaviors PASS: (1) results dropdown collapses immediately after selecting a result, (2) full-width Patient Snapshot renders with all 10 fields and DOB in '1973 Jul - 01' format, (3) 'Change Patient' reopens the results dropdown while keeping the snapshot visible, (4) click-outside on the page closes the results dropdown. Verified with admin, physician, and staff — all three see the 'Patients' sidebar item and can load /internal/patients. Search modes verified: name 'cru' -> 34 matches; PIN '2295' -> single-match auto-selects Cruickshank; phone '416' -> 40 matches. No regressions: Rx, Messages, Calendar navigation from sidebar all loaded without console errors. Pharmacy account is force-redirected to /change-password on login (temp password flow), so it cannot reach /internal/patients — role gating on the route works. Backend /api/internal/patient-lookup with pharmacy session returned 401 rather than 403 because the pharmacy session isn't fully authorized until password change; this matches the observed auth flow but differs from the spec's stated 403.

minor.issue: With pharmacy (temp-password) session, endpoint returns 401 instead of the spec-stated 403. Likely because the pharmacy user is not yet fully authenticated post-password-change. If a fully-provisioned pharmacy token should still be forbidden here, add a role check that returns 403 when the caller is authenticated but role=pharmacy. Access control is still enforced (no data leak), so severity is low.

ui_bugs.issue: For the Cruickshank test patient, snap-pharmacy renders an empty value (just the Building2 icon, no '—' fallback). Row() only shows '—' when children is falsy, but the icon+empty-string span is truthy. Consider rendering '—' when selected.current_pharmacy is empty.

action_items: (Optional) Return 403 from /api/internal/patient-lookup when caller is authenticated with role=pharmacy (currently 401 because pharmacy preview account is stuck in must-change-password state).
(Optional) Show '—' fallback in snap-pharmacy row when current_pharmacy is empty.
critical_code_review_comments: Patients.jsx click-outside handler is correctly scoped to searchRef via mousedown listener; teardown returns removeEventListener. Good.
run() auto-selects when results.length === 1 — nice UX; keep in mind that if the same single-result query is retried it will silently reselect without user click.
Change Patient does not clear the current selection; only reopens results — matches spec (snapshot must remain visible). OK.
Row() fallback '—' won't trigger when child is a JSX element with an empty string inside — see snap-pharmacy bug above.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 4 UX-fix behaviors verified for admin; role access verified for admin/physician/staff; pharmacy blocked)
